units.source_text: 源氏公子出门之时，众侍女都来窥看。

en.t: When Prince Genji went out through the gate, all the serving women came to steal a look at him.

units.source_text: 其时月落西山，光辉转明。

en.t: At that moment the moon was setting behind the western hills, and its light seemed even brighter.

units.source_text: 源氏公子映着月光，愁眉不展，神情异常清艳。

en.t: Prince Genji, bathed in the moonlight, wore an unrelieved look of sorrow, and his expression was extraordinarily pure and beautiful.

units.source_text: 即使是虎狼，看见了也会泣下，何况这些侍女都是从小与他亲近的人。

en.t: Even tigers and wolves would have wept at the sight of him, to say nothing of these serving women who had been close to him since childhood.

units.source_text: 她们看到他那优美无比的容貌，心中都异常激动。

en.t: Seeing his incomparably graceful face, they were all deeply moved.
